en.bdb: Example of the knavery of pine tree

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਧੈ ਚੀਲ ਓਜਾੜ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਚੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਉਚੀ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: vadhai cheel ojaaR vich uchai upar uchee hoiee|

en.bdb: Pine tree grows in a forest and goes high and higher.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੰਢੀ ਜਲਨਿ ਮੁਸਾਹਰੇ ਪਤ ਅਪਤ ਨ ਛੁਹੁਦਾ ਕੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: ga(n)ddee jalan musaahare pat apat na chhuhudhaa koiee|

en.bdb: Its nodes burn in torches and none touches its scorned leaves.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਾਉ ਨ ਬਹਨਿ ਪੰਧਾਣੂਆ ਪਵੈ ਪਛਾਵਾ ਟਿਬੀ ਟੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: chhaau na bahan pa(n)dhaanooaa pavai pachhaavaa Tibee Toiee|

en.bdb: No passerby sits under its shade because its long shadow falls over rough ground.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫਿੰਡ ਜਿਵੈ ਫਲੁ ਫਾਟੀਅਨਿ ਘੁੰਘਰਿਆਲੇ ਰੁਲਨਿ ਪਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: fi(n)dd jivai fal faaTeean ghu(n)ghariaale rulan paloiee|

en.bdb: Its fruit also bursts forth in curly pieces like that of a ball made of rags and moves around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਠੁ ਕੁਕਾਠੁ ਨ ਸਹਿ ਸਕੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਵਣੁ ਨ ਧੁਪ ਨ ਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: kaaTh kukaaTh na seh sakai paanee pavan na dhup na loiee|

en.bdb: Its wood is also not a good one, because it cannot bear water, air, sunshine and heat.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਗੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਵਿਝਵੈ ਜਲਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਗਿ ਖੜੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: lagee mool na vijhavai jaladhee haumai ag khaRoiee|

en.bdb: If fire breaks out in pine forest it does not extinguish soon and it further goes on burning itself in the fire of ego.
Giving it big size, God has made it useless and liable to destruction.
